title: Process to material edges
description: One group of edges from processes to materials (data/materials/edges/<group>.json). This file is the one owner of these edges. A process is a technique file or a process entry of a domain vocabulary.

group.description: The kind of process in this file: a technique file, or one process list of a domain vocabulary. Each process id in the file starts with the group and a colon.

process.description: technique:<id> for data/techniques/<id>.json, or <domain>.<list>:<id> for a vocabulary process.

acts_on.description: The materials that the process changes.

adds.description: The second materials that the process joins to it or puts on it.

sources.description: The sources for the edges of this process. They support each edge in the record.
